description: Juan Reyes Sierra, a UCF senior from Sarasota, Florida, shares his father’s account of September 11, 2001; Juan says he was not yet born when the attacks happened. His father was a manager at the Colony Beach and Resort in Longboat Key and helped coordinate logistics during President George W. Bush’s stay there on the morning of September 11. Juan says his father recalled preparations for a brunch menu and had a photograph taken with the president. According to the account Juan relays, his father learned of the unfolding events when Sarasota Airport closed and fighter jets were present; the family account describes fears that the president might be targeted. Juan presents the story as inherited family memory rather than a personal experience of the attacks, and says he feels proud to share his father’s connection to the president.

entities_and_facets.perspective: A UCF student's account of his father's experience, recalled and shared as family memory; the speaker was not born at the time and does not describe personal presence at an attack site.
